thread:
Ravi Patel: quick heads-up 1: Databricks DLT -> Pinecone connector pilot. Need to map responsibilities: Redwood provides connector shim + Dedicated perf profile; partner provides Pinecone managed endpoint and a marketplace listing draft.

Sofia Gomez: timeline? partner wants a soft-launch on marketplace in ~3 weeks. Also asked about required GPU sizing for their cert kit (they mentioned 'n1-standard-style' but want exact guidance).

Elena Park: for inference-heavy queries we recommend our 'dedicated-g4x' instance family for initial perf tests. We'll provide a premade TF serving image and a startup script. For embedding-only ingest the CPU path is fine.

Marcus Blake: small ask: the SI team wants a sample runbook for troubleshooting high-latency tails (p95/p99). Can we include common traces to watch and auto-remediation hooks?

Ravi Patel: yes. Runbook will include dashboards (per-route latency, queue depth), recommended autoscaler thresholds, and sample PromQL alerts. I'll draft.

Sofia Gomez: partner legal flagged Delta share retention: they only accept 7-day retention in marketplace listings. Can we support ephemeral ingest?

Elena Park: we can support ephemeral delta copies via time-travel snapshots + automated cleanup job. I'll add the snippet.

Marcus Blake: suggestion for announcement: split into two phases: 1) beta listing (no co-marketing) 2) verified integration + blog + joint webinar. That gives us room to fix any stability issues before PR.

MarketplaceBot: checklist update: marketplace-draft received from partner (v0.3). Required: security-scan, pricing-model, screenshots, 2x customer use-cases.

Sofia Gomez: logistical question: who owns the marketplace asset after launch? Partner wants Redwood to host listing under their partner account. We should confirm billing + leads flow.

Ravi Patel: Redwood will host the listing but leads should forward to partner and cc the SI team. We'll capture leads via UTM + form and forward nightly.

Elena Park: ingest snippet (DLT -> HTTP sink) draft:
```
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

# Structured Streaming write to HTTP sink (simplified)
(dlt.readStream("events")
   .select("id","embedding")
   .withColumn("emb_bytes", F.to_json(F.struct("embedding")))
   .writeStream
   .format("org.apache.spark.sql.http")
   .option("endpoint", "https://pinecone.partner/api/upsert")
   .option("method", "POST")
   .start())
```

Marcus Blake: perf bench plan: run three profiles --- ingest-only (5k eps), query-only (200 qps, 4k ctx), end-to-end (mixed 2k eps + 150 qps). We'll run on dedicated-g4x and report p50/p95/p99.

Sofia Gomez: marketplace assets: I'll handle screenshots and two short case studies. Need a partner contact and one SI customer quote.

Ravi Patel: partner contact is @james_hart (they're cc'd on the email thread). SI will try to surface a quote from the pilot next week.

MarketplaceBot: reminder: security-scan scheduled for 1910002800 UTC. Please ensure scan token is uploaded to vendor-console.

Elena Park: action items recap:
- Ravi: runbook & leads flow doc by Tue.
- Marcus: perf bench scripts + initial runs by Fri.
- Sofia: marketplace asset draft + screenshots by Thu.
- Me: DLT ephemeral snapshot script + ingest sample by Wed.

Ravi Patel: thumbs up. Scheduling a 30m prep call Wed 09:00 PT to walk through the runbook and bench plan. Invite incoming. :calendar:

Sofia Gomez: I'll invite partner PM and marketing. :rocket:

Marcus Blake: will have bench harness ready. Might need 1-2 tuning passes after the first run.

MarketplaceBot: link: https://marketplace.internal/partners/pinecone-dlt-redwood/v0.3 (preview).

Ravi Patel: thanks team. Will post updates and bench numbers in this thread.
